Maybach Jet Sprinter

The Maybach Jet Sprinter is the elite jet-on-wheels experience. The front half is a private jet cabin: four massage and reclining seats in Maybach leather, an executive table at every seat, a fridge, a drinks cooler and a wet bar. The back half is limousine, plush and quiet, behind a full partition finished with Maybach logos.
